issue.title: Make docs fails after 130
issue.body:
The following error is reported after attempting to make docs - due to permission errors. 
```
ubuntu@ubuntu:~/DroneCore$ make docs
(cd /usr/local/include/dronecore \
        && mkdir -p docs \
        && doxygen /home/ubuntu/DroneCore/.doxygen \
        && /home/ubuntu/DroneCore/generate_markdown_from_doxygen_xml.py docs docs)
mkdir: cannot create directory ‘docs’: Permission denied
Makefile:74: recipe for target 'docs' failed
make: [docs] Error 1 (ignored)
ubuntu@ubuntu:~/DroneCore$ 
```
If you do `sudo` it works, but the docs are created under **/usr/local/include/dronecore/docs/markdown** (which I suggest is not the best way).

Probably our previous behaviour would be good here. As part of docs build create /install/include/ etc etc. In any case, should not force sudo to build docs, or build them in such an unlikely location.

issue.title: Adding FollowMe plugin

repository.name: MAVSDK
repository.description: API and library for MAVLink compatible systems written in C++ 20

issue.body:
**Highlights of the FollowMe PR:**
- `FollowMe::start()` changes Flight mode to _FollowMe_
- For testing, we can set Follow info ` FollowMe::set_follow_info(const FollowMe::FollowInfo &info)` which involves initial position of Ground control station, etc.
- _FollowMe_ behavior can be configured using ` FollowMe::set_config(const FollowMe::Config &config)` as per [PX4 FollowMe configuration](https://docs.px4.io/en/advanced_config/parameter_reference.html#follow-target).
- FollowMe plugin periodically sends GCS location updates to Vehicle
- `FollowMe::stop()` leaves the device in _Loiter_
